posts.title: Five rules, one accident
posts.notes: Post the PDF as a document (swipeable).
posts.caption:
Five rules, one accident.

How everything we post is built, so it feels like one studio:

1. One grid: 72 px margins and an 8 px rhythm.
2. One typeface: Figtree, ExtraBold for headlines.
3. Whole footage: the work is never cropped or zoomed.
4. Exact numbers: real values from the sites, not adjectives.
5. One accident: a red exclamation mark, tilted 14 degrees like our logo, that lands last.

Happy accidents happen.

posts.title: Waiting is a design decision
posts.notes: HOLD until the date is confirmed. GTA VI was reaffirmed for 19 Nov 2026 by Rockstar and Take-Two in mid-2026; check Rockstar’s channels on 18 Nov. If it moved, skip this and use the open slot for something live.
posts.caption:
Waiting is a design decision.

A very big game (GTA VI) is due on 19 November, and a lot of people will spend a while looking at a loading bar. Whether that is dead air or a small moment is a choice somebody made.

Ours is a fallen exclamation mark. It is the one accident we keep.
